messages:
maria: Heads-up -- we need to decide retention + forwarding rules for a couple of log families before the next compliance audit. Proposal: keep infra/debug traces 30d, auth/privilege events 180d, and provide a limited SIEM feed to partners that only contains anonymized meta. Thoughts?

sam: sounds reasonable. who counts as a 'partner' here? external SOC vendors or internal analytics?

maria: external SOC vendors + legal-approved third parties for incident review. internal analytics still get raw stream. partners should receive only event metadata (no PII) and no raw payloads.

jordan: if we drop full traces to 30d we lose ability to do long-running incident forensics. can we keep 90d for any events flagged as "security-critical" and auto-promote when a ticket is opened?

leo: +1 to auto-promote. practical approach: two-tier retention policy + incident-triggered snapshot. baseline: traces=30d, auth=180d; security-critical gets snapshot preserved to S3-archive with CMK wrap.

security-bot: Reminder: existing policy PR #412 (https://rwd/internal/policies/log-retention) requires at least 90 days for auth logs in regulated workloads.

sam: regarding SIEM feed to partners — we should apply a filter. example filter:
```
forwarder.filters = ["type in ('auth','sso','threat')", "!payload.user_email", "anonymize: user_id => hash(user_id)"]
```
That drops PII and hashes identifiers.

maria: good snippet. on KMS: plan is envelope encryption and CMK in key rotation schedule. partners should never get unwrapped bundles. we need audit logs for key-ops surfaced to sec-team.

jordan: for vuln triage / evidence: propose a playbook step that takes a snapshot of related logs and assigns a timeboxed role to analysts (48h access). After the window, snapshot remains sealed and role auto-revoked.

leo: implementation idea: ephemeral role + presigned S3 URL for the snapshot + CMK-wrapped object. sample presign command (PoC):
```
aws s3 presign s3://rwd-sec-snaps/evt-2026-03-20.tar.gz --expires-in 172800
```
and use KMS:Encrypt on upload.

sam: need to ensure RBAC change process is followed: any new "forensic-analyst" group must go through IAM review, SCIM sync, and an approval ticket. also emit an audit event when a role is created/granted.

maria: can someone volunteer to run a short PoC that wires the forwarder filter + CMK-wrapped snapshots + ephemeral role flow? aim to demo on Thursday.

jordan: I can run the PoC. will push a branch with configs and a short runbook.

leo: I'll own the RFC to formalize retention windows and the auto-promotion trigger for incident tickets.

sam: I'll update the RBAC onboarding checklist and add the audit-emission requirement.

maria: thanks all. action items: jordan=PoC, leo=RFC, sam=RBAC checklist. I'll update the playbook with the 48h access pattern and the SIEM anonymization example. :thumbsup:

maria: note -- if anyone needs immediate access changes for an active incident, @oncall please escalate via the incident channel so we can do manual snapshot & wrap.

security-bot: Policy check queued (scan in 2h) — will post results here.
